about.introText: My name is Vinícius and I'm a Backend Engineer based in Blumenau, Santa Catarina, Brazil. I specialize in C#/.NET, designing and implementing services from the API to the database with Entity Framework and Dapper, always trying to understand the problem and the business context before writing the first line of code. Over 4 years I've built and modernized business-critical systems: multi-tenant ERPs, biometric authentication with AWS Rekognition, real-time features with SignalR, and industrial platforms. I also have solid full-stack experience with React, TypeScript and Vue.js, which lets me work end to end when needed. I'm currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Computer Science at FURB, and in 2026 I completed an academic exchange at Halmstad University, Sweden, studying Human-Centered AI, Big Data parallel programming and digital transformation.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.text: I'm always looking for learning, improving myself in technologies I already know and learning new technologies necessary for my daily routines. My work today is focused on the backend, with full-stack experience as a differential. Below are the technologies I use the most.

techs.title: C Sharp
techs.description: Knowledge in classes, OOP (objects, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, etc.), partial classes, interfaces, exception handling. Use of Entity Framework working code first (or not), inherited classes, with creation and maintenance of CRUD's, tables, link between tables 1:1, N:1, N:N; Use of LINQ, with performative projections in databases and several other uses. SignalR for seamless connections and real-time updates. Use of external libraries in the projects worked on. API projects, class libraries, console applications, etc.

techs.title: SQL
techs.description: Daily work with PostgreSQL and SQL Server: modeling, complex queries, joins, indexing and query optimization. Experience adapting database-specific SQL during a SQL Server to PostgreSQL migration.

techs.title: AWS Services
techs.description: Hands-on experience with S3 (document storage, multipart uploads), Rekognition/Face Liveness (biometric validation), EC2, IAM, VPC's, subnets, security groups and more.
